state.review: Adversarial review of the selected definitive business/authority owner boundary. Treat the supplied row as a proposal; do not infer omitted policy.

owners.declaredIdentity: Shared tenant+record address and foreign sentinels; RequestId-derived creation ID. Create compares mutable current content; revision exact retries stale. Expected physical append OCC.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant + caller InformationAssetId under the preserved shared technology-inventory address/sentinel scheme.
owners.invariant: One tenant inventory identity has one record kind and one revisioned information classification/retention/owner/lifecycle record.
owners.boundaryRationale: Shared type exclusion must survive; no rule requires all information assets together. Classification/retention values form one governed record, not its own collection lifecycle.

owners.mustPreserve: Kind is immutable; only active same-kind names are unique.
Kind is immutable; only active same-kind names are unique.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / management-assertions / assertionId; create compares current content/actor (not original after revise); approvals per version can replay; Revise expected revision before retry. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / management-assertions / AssertionId, with immutable ProgramId/examination scope. AssertionId identifies creation; selected mutations use CommandId and exact asserted version/source proofs.
owners.invariant: One exact current authored assertion version receives at most one immutable independent named CEO/CISO decision; revision creates changed wording/input bindings.
owners.boundaryRationale: Current version/proposer/signers and decision must stay atomic. Historical version bodies and past approvals are not needed in current state; separate immutable versions or historical reads preserve provenance.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / management-representation-letters / letterId; signature keyed by signer; changed artifact/time conflicts, identical signature no-ops before revision; handler supplies request.SignedAt. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / management-representation-letters / LetterId, with exact examination and document content. LetterId identifies creation; selected signature mutations use CommandId with the exact signer and version.
owners.invariant: Letter becomes signed exactly when every fixed named required signer has one immutable distinct signed artifact; no unlisted signer may sign.
owners.boundaryRationale: Required signer set and signatures jointly decide completeness/duplicate-artifact exclusion atomically. Signature artifacts themselves remain evidence aggregates, so retaining this fixed decision set is justified.

owners.declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 tenant+user. New episode minted on accepted re-registration. Current flags make some retries no-ops but no operation+episode identity fences old commands. Append OCC serializes member writes.
owners.selectedIdentity: Existing UUIDv5 of TenantId + UserId; membership episodes remain distinct and exact. Selected CommandId binds the original member/episode and intended transition.
owners.invariant: One tenant-user membership has one affiliation/expiry episode; deprovision closes authority and a fresh episode cannot start until authority cleanup completes.
owners.boundaryRationale: Affiliation, lifecycle and current episode must change together. Cleanup completion is an authority-release gate; membership roster/grants remain external.

owners.declaredIdentity: Platform bdgrz / methodology-templates / templateId; new version/review UUID minted within command, caller context.RequestId not passed. Create/revise/review/publish/retire retry checks include newly generated server timestamps. Pinned Portia uses full physical stream replay and expected physical position; no durable request dedup is supplied.
owners.selectedIdentity: Platform bdgrz + caller TemplateId; mutation CommandId is distinct from server-frozen version values.
owners.invariant: Publish current authored template only after independent review and distinct third-party approver; published content immutable; retirement stops further template revisions. Contributed records require exact accepted deidentified provenance.
owners.boundaryRationale: Current draft/review/approval must share version identity; prior immutable published version bodies and all historical accepted-contribution records need not remain live parent state. A compact retirement/publication authority can coordinate independently owned version lifecycles.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / methodology-template-contributions / contributionId; one immutable proposal; current review/acceptance immutable. Exact retries compare server generated ProposedAt/ReviewedAt/AcceptedAt and proposal only replays at revision1. Pinned Portia uses full physical stream replay and expected physical position; no durable request dedup is supplied.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / methodology-template-contributions / ContributionId, with exact immutable proposal/source/template lineage. ContributionId identifies creation; selected review/acceptance mutations use CommandId.
owners.invariant: Only immutable proposed deidentified record that receives independent approved review then acceptance by a third platform operator becomes shareable; tenant/source lineage stays in tenant-owned stream.
owners.boundaryRationale: These three irreversible decisions jointly authorize sharing one content capsule; separating author/review/acceptance without exact value/version gate would leak unapproved content. No retained child roster.
